evidence.runtimePolicy: Native guards and Java compilation are not actual Nginx proof. The dedicated Docker workflow must execute all 20 assertions with no skips, validate exact source hashes and actual 429/503 upstream observations, and verify owned cleanup. No local Docker execution or actual receipt is asserted by this file.
